description: This PHP class defines 'EmployeeSearchFilterParams', a data transfer object (DTO) that extends filter parameters for searching employees within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for various search criteria, such as employee name, ID, status, job title, subunit, supervisor, and location, along with validation and constants for allowed sorting and inclusion options.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for encapsulating employee search filter parameters, including search fields, constants for allowed sorts, inclusion modes, and methods for setting and validating these properties.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current setting for employee inclusion filter (current, past, or both).

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the employee inclusion filter, validating against allowable map values, and throws exception for invalid inputs.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Returns the combined name or ID filter.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Returns the list of employee numbers to filter.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers for filtering.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets supervisor employee numbers for filtering.
